_notes: YouTube RSS harvest sources. Every nightly build fetches each channel's RSS feed at https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id={channel_id}, extracts recent titles + descriptions, and stores intel in the archive snapshot. Tier: gold = weekly dated regional/local reports (highest signal); good = dated trip recaps with species/location; contextual = tactics/education mixed with trip content; seasonal = only meaningful during specific season windows. Region: 'northeast' (Zone 1), 'midatl' (Zone 2), 'both' (dual coverage). Verified 2026-08-23 with 8 Mid-Atl channels added.

channels.name: On The Water Media
channels.signature_pattern: Northeast Offshore Fishing Report [Month Day, Year]
channels.notes: Weekly Northeast Offshore Fishing Report + weekly Striper Migration Report. The single highest-value NE aggregator feed.

channels.name: My Fishing Cape Cod
channels.signature_pattern: [Month Day] Cape Cod Fishing Report | [species/spot]
channels.notes: Ryan & Kevin Collins — near-daily dated Cape reports (Monomoy, Vineyard Sound, Cape Cod Bay). Names guests + specific spots.

channels.name: Goose Hummock Shop
channels.signature_pattern: This Weeks Cape Cod Fishing Report / Capt [Name] got into the [species]
channels.notes: Cape Cod tackle shop; weekly dated reports naming specific endorsed captains and their catches ('Capt Scott Yelle got into the bluefin yesterday').

channels.name: Fisherman's Headquarters
channels.signature_pattern: LBI Fishing Report [M/D/YY] - [conditions summary]
channels.notes: 60+ year LBI tackle shop; dated LBI/Barnegat area reports with named species/conditions. Southern edge of the striper migration.

channels.name: The Fisherman Magazine

channels.notes: Capt. Bobby Rice and Outer Cape fleet — frequent dated trip clips (blitzes, tuna, shark).

channels.name: Saltwater Underground with Nick Honachefsky
channels.signature_pattern: S[N] EP[N] - [episode title] / [species] Fishing is ON FIRE

channels.name: Canyon Runner

channels.name: Jersey Nutz Sportfishing
channels.area: Manasquan, NJ → NY Bight offshore (mud hole, Coimbra, canyons)

Content is mostly podcast episodes discussing tuna in general — tier is `contextual`, not `gold`, so the model doesn't over-weight zone mentions in podcast titles. Occasional trip recap content justifies the slot.
